title: Fate/Type Redline
description: Showa 20. A record of Heroic Spirits fighting in the shadow of history. Akagi Kanata, a boy born to a faded mage bloodline, one day activates an hourglass-like Mystic Code in his grandmother’s house. When he wakes, he is in Tokyo, the Imperial Capital, in 1945, in the midst of the war. Together with a girl he meets there, Fujimiya Tsukumo, he is drawn into another war being fought behind the world war: a Holy Grail War.
author: Type-Moon
